scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
pairs: all shape pairs including same-shape controls
operators: grammar 'splice' with mate, 2 draws each order

naming.COMPOSE: both parents' distinctive positions (>= .5) present at >= .3 and the sets differ
naming.DOMINATE: within .15 of one parent and > .3 from the other
naming.NEW: > .3 from both parents and from every known centroid

new_shapes: NEW children clustered (k 2-4 by silhouette); centroids reported raw
material_rule: any NEW cluster with >= 5 members, or COMPOSE in >= 10 percent of cross-shape children
